preconditions.description: Attacker needs sufficient WBTC and DAI liquidity to manipulate the Uniswap WBTC/DAI pool
Attacker needs DAI tokens to manipulate the pool price

exploit_hint: Manipulate the Uniswap WBTC/DAI pool price by performing large swaps to distort the price, then exploit contracts that rely on the getPriceByWBTCDAI function for pricing. The attacker can artificially inflate or deflate the WBTC price to gain economic advantage in transactions that use this oracle.
